notes.title: Endhall is Out!
notes.content:
I just pressed the release button and Endhall is live!

Currently, there is a console window the comes up when the game is running. Feel free to minimize it and ignore any text/warnings you see there. I'll be posting a version that hides the console window in the next few days.

Enjoy!

- Ben

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.content:
I'm moving Endhall's release date to December 4th.

I know this might be a bit disappointing but I'm grateful for your patience and I hope you will all be just as excited to play the game next Tuesday!

- Ben
